items.label: Run the current Core default gate and classify whether Core can support accepted compatibility evidence.
items.evidenceTarget: Core package check outcome distinguishes default-gate pass from isolated test reproduction.
items.verificationNote: The original 2026-08-27 Core evidence recorded a default full-suite timeout at Core commit 969a21a4e888d836ae62164b206cb2dd34d5d702. The Core gate was refreshed on 2026-09-03 at Core commit 8de9e5082f3462e42fdff368d0cb380159da3713 after the PDF renderer pilot fixture output retirement: npm run check passed type-check and the default full Vitest run with 431 passed test files and 2,789 passed tests in 286.13s. This resolves the current Core default-gate blocker only; live Editor-to-Backend-to-Core evidence and broad truth promotion remain outside this item.

items.label: Run the current Editor gate against the current Core file dependency and inspect the Core adapter boundary.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor package metadata, core adapter, backend transport parser, runtime apply gates, and npm run check result support bounded Editor/Core compatibility.
items.verificationNote: Editor npm run check passed with 77 test files, 283 tests, and build. Production Core imports remain behind src/core/coreAdapter.ts; backend capability parsing compares Backend response facts to the Core adapter contract.

items.label: Run the current Backend gate against the current Core file dependency and inspect Backend capability, mutation, migration, and HTTP boundaries.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend package metadata, version capability envelope, HTTP routes, mutation service, migration service, and npm run check result support bounded Backend/Core compatibility.
items.verificationNote: Backend npm run check passed with 89 passed test files, 1 skipped file, 314 passed tests, 24 skipped tests, and build. Backend wraps VNEXT_CORE_VERSION_CAPABILITY_CONTRACT and executes Core public mutation and migration APIs behind revision gates.

items.label: Separate mocked/route-level contract evidence from live Editor-to-Backend-to-Core runtime evidence.
items.evidenceTarget: Existing tests identify whether a single accepted integration harness starts Backend, consumes it through the Editor client, and applies Core-backed results into Editor runtime.
items.verificationNote: Editor tests exercise createFlowDocBackendClient with mocked fetch/client boundaries, while Backend tests exercise createFlowDocBackendServer and routes directly. No accepted single test currently spans the real Editor client, real Backend server, and Core-backed document read/migration/mutation apply path.

items.label: Return a bounded evidence packet without promoting FlowDoc, Core, Editor, or Backend truth state.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records no node evidence ownership or truth-state promotion from this review.
items.verificationNote: Added work-scoped evidence and a verification document with empty nodeIds; FlowDoc remains planned and Core, Editor, and Backend remain unknown in the system map.
